This page explores the relationship between film runtime and IMDb rating. @fig-runtime-rating shows how ratings vary across films of different lengths.

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| label: fig-runtime-rating
#| fig-cap: "Film runtimes in minutes and IMDb ratings."

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb rating")
plt.show()
```


```{python}
#| echo: true

films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10
films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)
```
